votes.Reason: Each race is a separate experiment; race-by-race posts keep ten stories instead of one scoreboard, and the overall total is already on the site for anyone who wants it, so nothing is hidden.
votes.Risk: Some readers want one clear leader; the site's crown answers that.
votes.(a): Yes, it can push an AI that is behind overall to take bigger risks late in the month; that is realistic (a real manager also sees the whole fund) and it is part of what the experiment shows, so the AIs should keep seeing it. Hiding it would also contradict their stated goal.
votes.(b): Every race is scored on its own; the ten are added up only once, at the final scoring on Nov 28, and the running totals are on the site for anyone who wants them.
